errors.location: Method, Eq. (6) and the claimed logical implementation of P(α)
errors.description: The stated transversal operator does not implement the claimed logical phase gate: its phase varies across computational-basis terms of |0⟩_L, so it does not preserve the encoded state for general α.
errors.evidence: In Eq. (5), the term a=0,b=0,c=0 in |0⟩_L is |0000000⟩ and acquires phase 1 under Eq. (6). The term a=0,b=1,c=1 is |0110011⟩ and acquires phase e^{2iα}, from qubits 2 and 7. These phases differ for general α, contradicting Eq. (6)'s asserted action P(α)_L on the code space.

errors.location: Conclusions, final paragraph, resource bound and definition of m
errors.description: The stated gate-count bound and m choice contradict the manuscript's logarithmic lower bound and fail to refine the phase grid as ε tends to zero.
errors.evidence: The paragraph gives O(ε log[1/ε] log log[1/ε] ···) gates and m=⌈ε/[log₂(1/ε) log₂ log₂(1/ε)···]⌉. As ε→0, the first expression tends to zero, contradicting the earlier Ω(log[1/ε]) lower bound, while the displayed m tends to zero rather than increasing to provide arbitrarily fine dyadic phase approximations.
